summary: Describes considerations for mailing lists when non-ASCII UTF-8 email addresses are introduced. It outlines possible scenarios for lists that mix non-ASCII and traditional addresses, but does not specify protocol changes or offer implementation or deployment advice. It is informational.

eli5.summary: Mailing lists send one letter to many people. This memo thinks through what happens when some addresses use letters from other alphabets and some do not.
